name: A10-0073/2025 – Thomas Bajada – § 42/1
title: REPORT on the European Water Resilience Strategy
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘for example’ and ‘with proven concerns for human health and the environment, and only where there are safe alternatives;’
part_context: Insists that essential uses of PFAS, <del>for example</del> for medical devices, pharmaceuticals and products necessary for the transition to climate neutrality, are not endangered; calls on the Commission to propose to phase out forever chemicals (PFAS) in consumer goods with proven concerns for human health and the environment, and only where there are safe alternatives;
